name: Japheth
summary: One of Noah's three sons, who was saved with his family in the ark. Noah prayed that God would enlarge Japheth, and the island peoples came from his sons.

key_moments.title: Saved in the Ark
key_moments.description: Japheth went into the ark with his father Noah, his mother, his brothers Shem and Ham, and their wives.

key_moments.title: Covering Their Father
key_moments.description: Japheth and Shem laid a garment on their shoulders, walked in backward and covered their father without looking at him. Noah prayed that God would enlarge Japheth.
